dedupe_keys.name: p4 based telemetry processing for fast soft failure recovery in packet optical networks

description: Cugini and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The exact-title registered abstract describes in-network P4 processing of distributed multilayer telemetry to detect and recover from soft failures. Coverage is the reported recovery mechanism, whose actions are said to be enforced within a few microseconds. The metadata do not identify all sensors, fault classes, topology or delay-accounting boundaries. It documents an evaluated network-control mechanism without proving the same performance across arbitrary infrastructures. Availability and licence of the P4 implementation remain unknown. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The mechanism supports rapid optical-network recovery based on processed telemetry.
